units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 20:7">Gen. R. s. 20</cite> <he>אין תְּשׁוּקָתָהּ של אשה וכ׳</he> the wife’s longing is for her husband (<cite ref="Genesis 3:16">Gen. III, 16</cite>) <he>אין תְּשׁוּקָתוֹ של יצר וכ׳</he> the tempter longs for Cain and the like of him (ib. IV, 7); <he>אין תְּשׁוּקָתָן של</he> the rains long for the earth (<cite ref="Psalms 65:10">Ps. LXV, 10</cite>); <he>ואין תשוקתו של הקב״ה וכ׳</he> and the Lord longs for Israel (<cite ref="Song of Songs 7:11">Cant. VII, 11</cite>).
<cite ref="Song of Songs 7:11">Ib.</cite> <he>תשובי לתְשׁוּקָתֵךְ</he> return to thy desire; <he>תשובי לתְשׁוּקַת אישך</he> return to the desire for thy husband; a. e.—Pl. <he>תְּשׁוּקוֹת</he>.
Ib. ארבע ת׳ הן וכ׳ there are four desires (four Biblical passages containing the word t’shuḳah or its root); Yalk. ib. 32.
